name: @intellectual-frontiers/commons
description: IFC TypeScript, for the development of commons/ts: the pure kernel and the host runtime of Intellectual Frontiers Commons, on web standards and node: builtins (commons 0005-typescript-runtime). scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.kernel.json && tsc -p tsconfig.root-tests.json
